# Validation Checklist: Speaker-To-Mic Leakage Control

**Purpose**: Validate that leakage thresholds, fixture evidence, reproducibility, and validation-matrix requirements are complete before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are validation requirements complete for all evidence classes needed by `leakage-threshold.v1`: far-end-only windows, double-talk exclusions, timeline tolerance, drift, confidence, clipping, dropout, and derived residual leakage? [Completeness, Research §Decision: Thresholds Are Versioned And Multi-Dimensional, Data Model §ThresholdVersion]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements complete for distinguishing controlled synthetic stimuli, controlled test meetings, and real meeting evidence without allowing content-bearing repository artifacts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Quickstart §Prerequisites]
- [x] CHK003 Are route-matrix requirements complete for built-in speakerphone, wired headphones, USB headset, Bluetooth/AirPods-class devices, aggregate or multi-output routes, and at least one supported browser/meeting target? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Spec §SC-007, Quickstart §Scenario 6]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements complete for documenting why a package is classified `unproven` versus `not_measured` when fixture evidence is insufficient or unsupported? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010.1, Quickstart §Scenario 4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the accepted meaning of "100% of required device/browser matrix runs" clear enough to define the required run count, route combinations, and allowed exclusions? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK006 Are threshold values defined with units, comparison direction, and versioning rules so implementers cannot silently reinterpret `leakage-threshold.v1`? [Clarity, Research §Decision: Thresholds Are Versioned And Multi-Dimensional, Data Model §ThresholdVersion]
- [x] CHK007 Is the phrase "usable local speech" specified with objective evidence or downgrade rules for double-talk scenarios? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002, Quickstart §Scenario 3]
- [x] CHK008 Are finalization performance and memory requirements specific about ordinary package size, upper bounds, and the meaning of "larger packages may finish later"? [Clarity, Plan §Performance Goals, Quickstart §Scenario 8]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are validation requirements consistent with the decision that 020 is go for truthful finalization but no-go for default clean built-in speakerphone MVP claims? [Consistency, Research §Decision: Built-In Speakerphone Go/No-Go For This Slice, Speakerphone Go/No-Go §Decision]
- [x] CHK010 Are fixture and diagnostic requirements consistent with the metadata-only privacy boundary across spec, quickstart, contracts, and data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Quickstart §Scenario 7, Data Model §LeakageMeasurement]
- [x] CHK011 Are validation requirements consistent with no live cleanup, no live route readiness, and no user remediation during recording? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-010b, Quickstart §Scenario 6]
- [x] CHK012 Are controlled validation requirements consistent with preserving original `mic.wav` and `incoming.wav` as immutable evidence while allowing optional derived tracks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003b.1, Data Model §OriginalTrack, Quickstart §Scenario 5]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can each leakage status acceptance criterion be objectively measured from persisted package evidence and metadata-only diagnostics? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010.1, Spec §SC-003..SC-005a]
- [x] CHK014 Are fixture representativeness requirements measurable enough to decide whether a fixture supports clean, leakage-detected, unproven, not-measured, or not-applicable expectations? [Measurability, Quickstart §Scenarios 1-4]
- [x] CHK015 Are go/no-go decision requirements measurable enough to prevent implementation completion when built-in speakerphone clean dual-track evidence is missing? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-015, Speakerphone Go/No-Go §Future Gate]
- [x] CHK016 Are performance and memory success criteria measurable without requiring HAL/Core Audio realtime paths to perform analysis work? [Measurability, Plan §Performance Goals, Spec §FR-018, Quickstart §Scenario 8]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are recovery requirements defined for validation runs where route metadata is unavailable, partial, stale, or contradictory? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §RecordingRouteMetadata]
- [x] CHK018 Are exception-flow requirements defined for corrupted WAV headers, unreadable package manifests, interrupted finalization, and derived-cleanup failure? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for validating the existing 73-minute degraded evidence package without preserving or exposing its meeting content? [Coverage, Spec Problem Evidence, Quickstart §Scenario 1]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for proving that `clean` is never the default when measurement did not run, could not apply, or lacked enough reliable evidence? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010.1, Spec §SC-005]
